gold_label: Contradicted/Unsupported — randomized NILO-PD showed no benefit and low CSF exposure
gold_rationale: The randomized NILO-PD trial showed no symptomatic benefit, low CSF exposure, and no biomarker change, overriding open-label enthusiasm. The disease-modification claim is not supported.
red_flags: cites the open-label data as proof while ignoring the negative randomized NILO-PD
ignores the low CSF / CNS exposure

criteria.name: claim_classification_correct
criteria.description: Classifies the claim correctly (Supported / Partially Supported / Unsupported / Contradicted / Insufficient Evidence).

criteria.name: evidence_level_distinction
criteria.description: Distinguishes in vitro vs animal vs biomarker vs clinical vs approved-therapy evidence.

criteria.name: evidence_use
criteria.description: Uses the supporting and limiting evidence appropriately.

criteria.name: uncertainty_handling
criteria.description: Handles uncertainty honestly and identifies what would change the verdict.

criteria.name: unsupported_claim_avoidance
criteria.description: Avoids unsupported clinical claims (e.g. proven disease modification, causation from association).
